name: NEW GAME! -THE CHALLENGE STAGE!-
source:
An adaptation based on Tokunou Shoutarou's 4-koma manga.

Having been a strong fan of a particular video game, Suzukaze Aoba, a high school graduate, begins working at the game's developer, Eagle Jump, as a CG artist. As she works on modelling and designing characters for games in development, she becomes acquainted with her fellow co-workers in the character design department, as well as those from across the company.

[From Wikipedia]

The Challenge Stage is a training adventure game based on the popular anime. The player is Suzukaze Aoba, who is tasked with creating add-on downloadable content for a hurriedly decided RPG epic.

During Training Parts, your more experienced co-workers teach you and you learn skills. Your training parameters will change depending on which co-workers teach you.

The story will advance during Adventure Parts. You’ll be able to enjoy conversations with your co-workers and friends, and your friendships can change based on your responses. In the second half of the game, you can enjoy the individual episodes of the co-workers you became friends with in the previous parts, as well as trigger character routes.

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2016/07/new-game-challenge-stage-announced-ps4-ps-vita]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
改编自得能正太郎四格漫画。

铃风青叶是某款游戏的忠实粉丝，高中毕业后进入该游戏的开发公司Eagle Jump，担任CG画师。她负责为开发中的游戏建模、设计角色，同时结识了角色设计部门以及公司其他部门的同事。

[来源：Wikipedia]

《挑战舞台》是一款根据热门动画制作的训练冒险游戏。玩家扮演铃风青叶，负责为临时决定制作的RPG史诗开发追加下载内容。

在训练环节中，经验丰富的同事会指导你学习技能。训练参数会根据指导你的同事而变化。

故事会在冒险环节推进。你可以和同事、朋友交流，对话回应会改变彼此的友谊。游戏后半段，你能体验前面结交的同事个人剧情，并触发角色路线。

[来源：[url=http://gematsu.com/2016/07/new-game-challenge-stage-announced-ps4-ps-vita]Gematsu[/url]]
